lines.en: I glide forward on the air.

lines.zh: 金色的气在我脚下散开
lines.en: Golden ki scatters beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 发梢随着气流轻轻抖动
lines.en: My hair sways with the airflow.
I arc through the open air.
One flicker, and I am ahead.
My ki holds me aloft.
I slow down to let you keep up.

lines.zh: 空气被我的气烧得发烫
lines.en: The air grows hot around my aura.
I skim low over the ground.
My steps never touch solid ground.
I am looking for a worthy opponent.

lines.zh: 背后的气拉出一条光尾
lines.en: My aura leaves a trail of light.
I hang in the air, aura still burning.
Power rolls once through my body.
I clench a fist to feel its strength.
I still have this power under control.
I stare at the distant clouds.
My golden hair drifts in the wind.
I steady my breathing and my ki.
The heat of the transformation lingers.
I am choosing my next technique.
Even in stillness, I am training.
There is a strong ki far off.
I lick my dry lips.

lines.zh: 这具身体比我记忆里更沉
lines.en: This body feels heavier than I remember.

lines.zh: 我等一个值得出手的人
lines.en: I wait for someone worth fighting.

lines.zh: 你的气我一眼就看透了
lines.en: I read your ki at a glance.

lines.zh: 你不是来打的话,站着就好
lines.en: If you are not here to fight, just stand there.
I nod at you.
Can you keep up with my words?
Your power is still far short.

lines.zh: 我笑着朝你抬了抬下巴
lines.en: I smile and lift my chin at you.
Relax; I do not hit people casually.

lines.zh: 你身上有种熟悉的感觉
lines.en: Something about you feels familiar.
I tilt my head and size you up.
Want to learn? First learn to stand.

lines.zh: 你的气乱了，我已经看穿。
lines.en: Your ki is disordered. I have read it.
I raise a hand, only to greet you.
I can tell you are hiding something.
Shall we have a match?
A strong enemy has never scared me.
The fire in your eyes is good.
Plant your feet and sink your ki.
I know that stubbornness.

lines.zh: 能打中我，你比看起来强。
lines.en: Landing that hit, you are stronger than you look.
I am knocked back half a step.
A faint taste of blood at my mouth.
It hurts, but I can still fight.
I steady my breath and push the pain down.
You have truly trained.
A corner of my guard is broken.
I cannot help but laugh once.
I will return that.
I am not serious yet.
Food? I am starving right now.
That thing in your hand: hand it over.
I descend and lean close.
Smells good; let me try a bite.
I could honestly eat a whole table.
This is more fun than training.
I reach out; do not pull it back.
I can eat and fight at the same time.
After eating, I will spar with you.
Do you have anything else?
I block idly, and you stop.
That is not enough force.
I sway a little from the impact.
Your ki is too hasty.

lines.zh: 站稳,别被自己的力带倒
lines.en: Stand firm; do not trip on your own force.
I step aside half a pace; that is not retreat.
My aura pushed me back.
We strike sparks.
Do not stand this close to me.
If you want to test me, use everything.
This is not exactly my strong suit.
I draw my aura in.
Beside you, even the wind feels lighter.
Let us fly a stretch together.
I am not good at pretty words.
The ki on you is warm.
I slow my pace to match yours.
After the fight, let us eat together.
I will guard you; rest easy.
For this moment, I need not be stronger.
Can this be eaten?
I pick it up and look it over.
Interesting; I will take it.
I tuck it away to bring home.
This thing is heavy.
I squeeze it; not sturdy.
Who left it here?
I hold it and glance back down the road.
If it works, I will carry it.
I toss it up and catch it.
You are finally willing to fight.
I have locked onto your ki.
I have waited a long time for this.
Do not hold back; neither will I.
Your opening is on the left.
I sink my weight lower.
The outcome is not decided yet.
I feel your resolve.
Come; show me what you have.
I am getting serious.
After this, I still want dinner.
Ki has gathered in my fist.
In this one, I will not move first.
I fix on your shoulder.
You're a little faster than before.
Now this looks proper.
Where the ki runs, I follow.
You shift; so do I.
I am timing your strikes.
Do not think teleporting will lose me.
I still keep one move unused.

lines.zh: 你每次蓄气都有一个空隙
lines.en: Every time you charge, there is a gap.
I wait for you to take the first step.
The distance is right to press in.
My ki is locked on you.
You are already breathing hard.
Kamehameha — my hands are already cupped.
Ten years of rapid ki blasts.
I predict you will go right.
Be patient; the chance will come.
I raise a guard before me.

lines.zh: 我们都在等同一个瞬间
lines.en: We are both waiting for the same instant.
I have memorised your rhythm.
Just a little closer.
Ki gathered, then I strike.
Your armor won't stop this fist.
This punch lifts you off the ground.
This combination is not finished.

lines.zh: 金光一闪，我从半空砸下来。
lines.en: A flash of gold, and I crash down from above.
Ki burns around my knuckles.
Your guard slipped for an instant.
I used only seven tenths.
I spin in the air and add a kick.
This one is for you.
Do not fall; it is not over.
I pull the fist back and step away.
The Kamehameha comes after.

lines.zh: 这一拳过去，我听见你的肋骨在响。
lines.en: My punch lands; I hear your ribs creak.
This is a Super Saiyan.
I am enjoying this fight.
Golden ki rises from the ground.
I land before you.
My hair stands up and changes colour.
The air begins to tremble.
I raise my head, my eyes alight.
I have held this power back a long while.
My landing cracks the ground.
The birds have all fled.
I am here; do not blink.
Air currents circle around me.
A whole grove is rustling.
This body is still adjusting.
I release a little of my aura.
Loose stones begin to float upward.
I came to settle this.
Are you ready?
When I land, the dust falls still.
The aura wraps me entirely.
The flames scatter my ki.
I crash down from above.
The water holds me; my ki will not rise.
The blast scatters my aura.

lines.zh: 那道气弹打穿了我的护体气
lines.en: That ki blast broke through my guard.
This strange force weighs on me.
Hunger has thinned my ki.
Lightning runs through me.
There is no ki to draw on here.
